purpose: One directed real-model observation of cancellation-to-abort handoff under immediate close; not a rerun of successful late supply or performance measurement.
execution_owner: Dedicated GPU owner only; this task performs no server/model execution.
preflight: Freeze and independently review a new cancel-only helper/config: the old validator/controller assumes late3+cancel1 and must not be invoked unchanged.
Bind model/tokenizer/template/generation, source archive and each relevant native method source hash; use the exact saved cancel message.
Check all nine ledgers listed at r2 and any later GPU-owner ledger bindings, create a fresh permanent cap1 unit, and retain original r1/r2 results.
No model calls during local observer tests; observer failures are failures, not silent absence of evidence.
Claim fresh owned lease only through the existing GPU-owner process and verify idle resources.

event_chain.note: Close adoption is cleanup-owned abort, not proof that a late original cancel RPC was accepted.
Keep distinct timestamps; enqueue is not send or worker/native entry.

Wrap actual bound AsyncLLM.abort/shutdown while preserving arguments, original await/thread behavior and exceptions. Keep old adapter-entry observation separately named; it is not a native call witness.
Observed OS/GPU exit never changes logical unknown or releases its recorded credits retrospectively.

acceptance: Trigger cancellation only after original native admission and before any observed matching final output. If the window is missed, stop and retain the spent attempt; do not retry.
Require a matching original native abort entry and its relation to shutdown, not just adapter-entry, finish_reason=abort, API shutdown or physical exit.
Report direct Core-RPC cancellation and close-owned adoption separately. A late RPC returning requested=False must remain false even if cleanup later invokes abort.
The queue handoff may pass while the result remains unknown/AbortNotConfirmed. Preserve InterruptedError, all actual usage, full TaskKey, held credit/input refs and original narrow API/GPU fields.
If an abort worker never starts or a native abort never returns, retain that explicit gap and stop without retry; do not fix the outcome by skipping a check.
Verify all observed owned birth identities and GPU/SHM/RPC state with the existing supervisor/resource owner, retain artifacts, and do not touch old successful units.
stop_conditions: first observer, source, identity, budget or resource error
native request finished before cancellation trigger
matching request naturally finishes before native abort entry: record the propagation window as inconclusive, retain the spent attempt, and do not retry
not_claimed: native physical request terminal confirmation from abort return
